replacements.find: 'hint' => 'disable it instead; deleting would cascade these rows away',
replacements.note: AdminController has no injected translator and is constructed by the router, so resolve() is used rather than a constructor change. Note this body is only reachable via DELETE /api/lmx/reactions/{id}, which no screen calls today — the admin UI offers disable instead. Translated anyway because it is a user-facing `hint` on a 409 and the next UI that adds a delete button will render it.

deferred.reason: These 31 names are seeded into the `reactions.display` COLUMN by migrations/2026_08_13_120002_seed_catalog.php and served from the DB on the forum payload, so they are not a string in the JS at all — forum.js reads r.display in eight places (icon() alt, the picker preview, both chip titles, the reactors modal, the thread filter chips, the admin rows). They are also admin-editable: AdminController's PATCH accepts `display`. A translation key would therefore silently override a rename an admin made on the catalogue screen, which is a precedence decision this lane cannot make alone.
deferred.what_it_would_take: The keys are already written and shipped: local-looksmax-reactions.forum.reaction.<slug> in both locale files, for all 31 slugs. Wiring is one helper in js/dist/forum.js — `function name(r) { return window.lmxI18n.t('local-looksmax-reactions.forum.reaction.' + r.slug, {}, r.display); }` — plus replacing r.display with name(r) at forum.js:91, 245, 286, 306(fallback), 331, 490, 510, 626 and admin.js:28, 82. The precedence rule to agree first: either (a) the key always wins, and the admin `display` column becomes an English-only fallback for reactions added after this catalogue, or (b) the DB wins when it differs from the seeded value, which needs the seed value kept alongside it. (b) is correct but needs a schema column.

deferred.reason: XenForo's own byline for an imported post — 'Alice, Bob and 12 others'. It is stored data, in English, with no structure to interpolate; ReactorsController.php:94 keeps it verbatim on purpose because most of the names in it are 'Deleted member 6401' and there is no id to resolve. It cannot be translated without re-parsing 381k rows.
deferred.what_it_would_take: A migration that re-parses the scraped byline into (names[], othersCount) so the sentence can be rebuilt from a key. Worth doing only if the byline is judged worth keeping at all.
